messages:
alex: Evening handoff — quick status + watches for night shift. I'm off at 18:00 PT. TL;DR: no incidents, but watch embedding latency on r4-pool (~p95 increase last hour). I left a short checklist below.

maria: Thanks — who owns r4 today if it flares?

sam: I can cover infra for the first half of the night (until 02:30 UTC). I'll be watching autoscale and queue depth.

jia: FYI I'll be OOO 23:00-03:00 UTC (maintenance window). Sam covering me for rollout approvals.

alex: Watch list: 1) Embedding p95 for r4-pool up ~30% (dashboard -> Observability > embeddings > r4). 2) Bursty small requests from vendor-x seen earlier (rate-limited now). 3) Canary traffic tomorrow at 02:00 UTC (jia owns).

maria: Action items for oncall: - If embed p95 > 800ms for 5m, switch routing to redwood-embed-quantized-v1 fallback and notify infra. - If errors spike >1% 5m, escalate to eng-sre channel and page.

sam: Command to flip routing (in case):
```bash
# switch traffic to quantized fallback
curl -X POST "https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/routing/switch" \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $RW_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"pool":"r4-pool","target_model":"redwood-embed-quantized-v1"}'
```

oncall-bot: Reminder: autoscaler policy r4-pool will evaluate every 10m. Current desired: 6 -> actual: 6.

alex: Quick checks I performed before leaving: - restarted one stuck worker on r4-12 (svc: inference-worker-12) - cleared a stale cache for prefix hashing - validated canary test passes locally (small sample)

jia: noted on the canary. I'm leaving the canary runbook here: <https://internal.redwood.ai/runbooks/canary-deploy>. If canary fails, rollback steps 2-4 are listed.

maria: I'll set a short dashboard annotation for the embedding spike and add the pager policy. Sam — when you confirm stable, drop a quick :thumbsup: here so I can close watch.

sam: Affirmative. Will monitor for 45m and report back.

alex: One-off FYI: vendor-x rate limit tweak was applied in traffic router (config: vendorx.rate_limit=120/min). Monitor for 429s.

maria: all right, leaving pager rules in place. Good handoff — thanks everyone, have a good evening. :v:

sam: :thumbsup: will update if anything changes.

oncall-bot: Note: Next rotation reminder sent to @sam in 12h.
